subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence needs (Acme Corp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>, Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.example.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence needs (Acme Corp)

Hi Sam / Lydia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Wanted to send a quick recap of what we heard and the proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Summary of pain / goals
- Primary goal: real-time content generation for support responses while maintaining strict auditability and retention controls.
- Pain points: inability to produce reliable audit logs tied to requests, long retention policies for regulated data, and limited ability to provide SOC 2 evidence to auditors.
- Requirements called out: SOC 2 Type II report, access to request-level audit logs (at least 90 days, preferably 1 year), DPA with data residency clauses, and the most recent pen test summary.

What we proposed
- Redwood hosted inference with dedicated capacity for sensitive workloads, offering per-request audit logs and configurable retention.
- SOC 2 Type II report and pen test summary (we can provide redacted versions for sharing).
- DPA template attached; we can accept a limited redline and run through legal.

Open questions / asks from Acme
1) Does Redwood provide request-level logs that include model version and prompt text?
2) Can retention be configured per-customer to meet Acme’s 1-year retention requirement?
3) Any additional compliance packages or on-prem/private options if needed?

Next steps
- I’ll send the SOC2 summary, pen-test stub, DPA draft, and a short sample of audit logs (attached). (Action: Marissa — today)
- Rishi will follow up with an initial config sheet and cost delta for dedicated capacity and longer retention. (Action: Rishi — EOD Tuesday)
- Sam / Lydia to confirm which data residency region they require and whether auditors will need a full SOC 2 package or a redacted report. (Action: Acme — 48 hours)

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (stub), PenTest-Summary-2025.pdf (stub), DPA_Redwood_v1.docx (draft), Audit-logs-sample.csv (stub)

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@acme.com>, Ben Shaw <ben.shaw@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence needs (Acme Corp)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- For audit logs we need request-level metadata that can be correlated to user IDs and timestamps. Prompt text can be redacted for privacy but we need a record that a request was processed and which model/version responded.
- Retention: Acme requires a default of 1 year for production logs; for legal we may need exportable archives for audits.
- DPA: we’ll share our standard DPA with comments but happy to start with your template.

Can you confirm whether the hosted offering exposes model version in the logs today, or if that’s part of the dedicated/private feature set? Also appreciate the pen test summary and redacted SOC2.

If you can share the docs and a short sample log, I’ll loop in procurement and legal.

Sam
Sam Turner
Security Engineering Manager, Acme Corp
sam.turner@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.example.com>, Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence needs (Acme Corp)

Appreciate the clarity, Sam. Quick answers inline: 

- Model/version in logs: yes — Redwood’s audit logs include model identifier and runtime binary hash for each request today for Dedicated and Hosted customers. We can also surface that for hosted customers on request.
- Retention: retention is configurable per-customer; default is 90 days on hosted, but Dedicated customers can opt into 1 year+ retention. We can export archives in CSV/JSON for audit purposes.
- DPA: attached is our standard DPA (DPA_Redwood_v1.docx). Feel free to redline; I’ll get legal engaged once I see comments.

Attached (stubs):
- SOC2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted)
- PenTest-Summary-2025.pdf (redacted)
- Audit-logs-sample.csv (contains request_id, user_id (hashed), model_id, timestamp, latency_ms)
- DPA_Redwood_v1.docx (editable)

Next practical steps: 
1) Marissa to share attachments and a short technical sheet for audit logs (done).
2) Rishi to prepare a cost delta and deployment recommendation (dedicated vs hosted with extended retention). ETA: Tue 2026-06-23 EOD.
3) Acme to share DPA redlines and confirm region (us-east / us-west / eu) within 48 hrs.

If helpful, we can schedule a short 30-min session with our infra lead to walk through retention/export and log formats — open slots Tue/Wed mornings PT.

—
Marissa
From: Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example.com>, Sam Turner <sam.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Shaw <ben.shaw@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 17:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence needs (Acme Corp)

Thanks Marissa — received the attachments and initial samples. We’ll review with legal and procurement.

Immediate answers:
- Region: us-east preferred.
- DPA: procurement will send redlines by Tue EOD.
- Auditors: they will initially accept redacted SOC2 for evaluation; if they request the full package we’ll request it then.

Please go ahead and schedule the 30-min tech walk-through for Tue 2026-06-23 09:00 PT if that slot is available.

Lydia
Procurement Lead, Acme Corp
lydia.gomez@acme.com
